theme: How often to save when the machine may crash
title: Bad Node, Good Node: History-Conditioned Checkpoint Intervals
strategies: never checkpoint, always restart from scratch on failure (trivial baseline)
closed-form Young/Daly interval from the GLOBAL average failure rate, fixed for the whole run (greedy, the obvious textbook recipe)
walk the timeline segment by segment, sizing each interval from a LOCAL windowed failure-rate estimate so a bad node's burst gets short intervals and calm stretches get long ones (strong)

true offline-optimal checkpoint placement via full dynamic programming over the exact failure/restart interaction (open ceiling, uncovered -- the timing feedback loop between schedule and which failures get hit makes exact search expensive)
